definitions.explanation: A fracture or zone of fractures between two blocks of rock that have moved relative to each other.
A significant gap or break between groups, generations, or concepts.

examples.japanese: {活断層|かつだんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: It's dangerous to build structures on top of an active fault.

examples.japanese: {断層|だんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれて→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: An earthquake occurred when the fault slipped.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{断層|だんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: A major fault runs through this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世代間|せだいかん}→世代間：28752_sedaikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断層|だんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。

⟦{都市部|としぶ}→都市部：14549_toshibu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧な{断層|だんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an economic gap between urban and rural areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{早|はや}すぎて、⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧リテラシー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断層|だんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれている→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: Technology is advancing so fast that a gap in information literacy between generations is emerging.

notes:
USAGE: In Japan, {断層|だんそう} is an important term due to the country's seismic activity. Many major earthquakes are caused by fault movements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断層|だんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれる→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧ (a fault slips)
- {活断層|かつだんそう} (active fault)
- {断層帯|だんそうたい} (fault zone)
- {断層線|だんそうせん} (fault line)

TYPES OF FAULTS:
- {正断層|せいだんそう} - normal fault
- {逆断層|ぎゃくだんそう} - reverse fault
- {横|よこ}ずれ{断層|だんそう} - strike-slip fault

FIGURATIVE USAGE: {断層|だんそう} is commonly used figuratively to describe gaps between generations (⟦{世代間|せだいかん}→世代間：28752_sedaikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{断層|だんそう}), social classes, or cultural values.

RELATED TO EARTHQUAKES: Japan has many {活断層|かつだんそう} (active faults), and the study of faults is crucial for earthquake preparedness.
